newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Two of 18 vessels operating at Brazil Santos port.
newsitem.headline: Two of 18 vessels operating at Brazil Santos port.

text.p: Two of 18 ships docked at Brazil's Santos port were operating Wednesday in an ongoing stevedores strike, a port authority spokesman said.
The two ships were loading and unloading chemical and petroleum products, he added.

Two ships had left the port since the strike began at 0700 local/1000 GMT Tuesday. One ship had left after it had already finished loading containers before the strike began and the other vessel had finished loading chemicals at a private terminal.
Some 15 ships were in the bay waiting to dock, unchanged from Tuesday, the spokesman said.
Last night stevedores decided to go on a national strike in sympathy with their colleagues at Santos port at midnight Thursday (0300 GMT Friday) for 48 hours.
The Santos stevedores are protesting against steel firm Cosipa using its own workers to load and unload vessels at its private terminal at the port.
